changelog: - **A Gate that feeds a Converter no longer loses its share of a Pool to another node on the way.** Where a Converter is fed by Gates or other Converters, the engine plans the whole group at once, at the turn of its first node. It set aside what the group’s Converters would take from their Pools, but not what a Gate of the group was planned to take from its own Pool. A node outside the group whose turn came in between could take it: a Pool of 5, a Gate planned to take 1 for its Converter, and another Converter taking up to 5 from the same Pool left the Gate with nothing, and the group’s Converter was fed on one input only and made half an item out of a whole input, with no notice. The Gate’s planned amount is now set aside for it as well, so the group moves what it planned and the other node gets what is left (4 here). On a model where two nodes compete for one Pool this can change which of them is served first, and the total moved can be smaller. None of the bundled examples changes. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 13).
